kernel: An adventure in the 1880s. You and your partner, two ex-soldiers turned confidence men, sign a contract to cross the frontier into a country no Englishman has seen and make yourselves its kings. I want the rise to be glorious and the ambition to cost something, and I want the partnership to be the heart of it.

mediation.question: Can two loafers make themselves kings, and what does the crown cost the friendship that won it?

T1.title: Kings of Kafiristan
T1.motivation: You start out a partner in a scheme to be king; you end carrying your partner's crowned head home, because you swore never to leave him.

ending.title: And There the Matter Rests
ending.summary: You come back to the newspaper office a year later, broken and crippled, with Dravot's head in a horsehair bag and his gold crown on it, and you die of the sun a few days after. The head is never found.
ending.changed: nothing is left of the kingdom but a story the newspaperman can tell

N01.title: Brother to a Prince
N01.summary: On a train in Central India you meet a newspaperman and ask him to carry a message to your partner Dravot at Marwar Junction. You are loafers who blackmail small native states by posing as correspondents; he gets you both warned off the border.
N01.image: a red-bearded man leaning from a train window at Marwar Junction

N02.title: The Contrack
N02.summary: Two years later you and Dravot walk into the newspaperman's office at midnight. India is not big enough for you: you are going to Kafiristan to be kings. You show him your contract: no liquor, no women, and stand by each other till the work is done.
N02.image: the contract on the office table, signed Gentlemen at Large

N03.title: The Mad Priest
N03.summary: Dravot goes north as a mad priest with whirligigs to sell, you as his servant, twenty Martini rifles hidden under the toys. Past Jagdallak, the camels left behind, you walk into a country no Englishman has seen.
N03.image: whirligigs and mud toys hiding the rifle barrels

N04.title: A God in a Valley
N04.summary: You come down into a valley where two villages fight, and Dravot shoots a man at long range. The people bow down: he is a god, a son of Alexander. Village by village you drill an army, settle quarrels, and make chiefs of men like Billy Fish.
N04.image: a crowd kneeling in the snow before a red-bearded man

N05.title: The Master's Mark
N05.summary: Under an old stone idol the priests find the Master Mason's mark, and when Dravot shows them the secret signs they take him for a god indeed. He opens a Lodge and makes himself Grand Master. He dreams of an empire, and of handing it to the Queen.
N05.image: the Master Mason's mark under a stone idol

N06.title: Keep Clear of Women
N06.summary: Dravot wants a queen and a son. You remind him of the Contrack; Billy Fish says a god may not marry a mortal girl. He takes one anyway. At the wedding she bites his neck and draws blood: neither god nor devil, but a man.
N06.image: a girl's teeth marks bleeding on a king's neck

N07.title: The Rope Bridge
N07.summary: The army turns. Billy Fish stays to die with you. Dravot walks out onto the rope bridge in his crown and asks you to forgive him; you do. He shouts to them to cut, and falls, turning, a long way. They crucify you between two pines and, when you live, let you go.
N07.image: a gold crown on a man falling from a cut rope bridge

N08.title: And There the Matter Rests
N08.summary: You crawl back to the newspaper office with Dravot's head in a black horsehair bag, the gold crown on it, and tell everything. Two days later you are in the road, singing a hymn. You die in the asylum, of the sun.
N08.image: a crowned head in a black horsehair bag

C01.label: your partner
C01.name: Daniel Dravot
C01.wants: to be a king, then an emperor, then a god
C01.edge: magnificent, reckless, and convinced of his own divinity
C01.voice: "I won't make a Nation, I'll make an Empire!"
C01.breaking_point: breaks the Contrack to take a queen

C02.label: the newspaperman
C02.name: the narrator
C02.wants: a quiet night and a story

C03.label: the chief who stands by you
C03.name: Billy Fish
C03.voice: grave and faithful to the end

C04.label: the priests
C04.name: the priests
C04.wants: a god who is truly a god
C04.edge: the power that made Dravot and can unmake him
C04.voice: "Neither God nor Devil but a man!"
